column1: # tools/job_aliases.tsv - job id aliases (TESTREORG).  Tab separated, header line first.  Read by tools/job_resolve.sh, tools/job_path.sh and tools/stampkeys.py (resolve_id).
#   old_id   the job id used until stage 9 (old stamps, journal text, test script comments)
#   new_id   the ACTIVE id since stage 10 (ids renamed last): what run_changed.sh / run_job.sh / the stamps (as fid) / jobclass.txt / the xfail list / test/jobs.tsv call the job.  = planned.
#   planned  the planned name = test/jobs.tsv new_name (without a '?' marker).  Stage 10: identical to new_id (kept so the table says what the plan was and old command lines with it still resolve).
# A token that is none of the three passes through unchanged.  Every tool that takes a job id resolves it through this table, so old ids keep working on every command line.
# tools/jobs_check.sh verifies the table against test/jobs.tsv (new_id = jobs.tsv id = new_name) and that jobclass.txt / the xfail list / h01_heap use the new ids only.
